    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractAction
    Abstract base class for action implementations.
    AbstractRequirement
    Abstract base class for requirement implementations.
    Action
    Represents an executable action within the KLibrary action engine.
    ActionBarAction
    Sends an action bar message to the target player.
    ActionConfigDeserializer
    Deserializes Action instances from configuration nodes.
    ActionFactory
    Factory for creating Action instances from configuration data.
    ActionPipeline
    Executes a sequence of Actions within an execution context.
    ActionRegistry
    Registry for action types and their factories.
    ActionResult
    Represents the outcome of an Action execution.
    ActionResult.Failure
    Represents a failed action execution.
    ActionResult.Skipped
    Represents an intentionally skipped action execution.
    ActionResult.Success
    Represents a successful action execution.
    ArmorModifier
    A modifier for applying armor trims to armor items.
    AttributeModifierModifier
    A modifier for manipulating attribute modifiers on an item.
    BackButton
     
    BackOrCloseButton
     
    BaseButton
    Standard implementation of Button that combines an ItemStack template with configurable click actions and view requirements.
    BaseButton.Builder
    Builder for constructing BaseButton instances.
    BroadcastAction
    Broadcasts a MiniMessage-formatted message to all online players.
    BroadcastSoundAction
    Broadcasts a sound to all online players.
    BroadcastWorldAction
    Broadcasts a MiniMessage-formatted message to all players in the same world as the target player.
    BroadcastWorldSoundAction
    Broadcasts a sound to all players in the same world as the target player.
    BukkitConfigNode
    A ConfigNode implementation backed by Bukkit's ConfigurationSection.
    Button
    Represents a clickable element in a GUI inventory.
    ChanceRequirement
    A probabilistic requirement that passes based on a random chance.
    ChatAction
    Makes the target player send a chat message.
    CloseButton
     
    CommandAction
    Unified command action supporting both player and console execution.
    CommandAction.Executor
    The command executor mode.
    ConditionalAction
    Executes actions conditionally based on requirement evaluation.
    ConfigNode
    A format-agnostic abstraction over configuration entries.
    ConfigurableInventoryProvider
    Config-driven implementation of InventoryProvider that creates inventory GUIs from configuration data.
    ConsoleCommandAction
    Executes a command as the console.
    CooldownRequirement
    Enforces a per-player cooldown before the requirement can pass again.
    DamageModifier
    A modifier for setting item durability/damage values.
    DelayAction
    Wraps child actions and executes them after a configurable delay.
    DisplayModifier
    A composable modifier for setting the display name and lore of an item using the Adventure Component API and MiniMessage formatting.
    EconomyService
    Service for interacting with the server's economy system via Vault.
    EnchantmentModifier
    A modifier for adding, removing, or clearing enchantments on an item.
    ExecutionContext
    Shared execution context passed to all actions and requirements.
    ExecutionContext.Builder
    Builder for constructing ExecutionContext instances.
    FlagModifier
    A modifier for adding or removing ItemFlags on an item.
    GamemodeRequirement
    Checks whether a player is in a specific game mode.
    GeneralModifier
    A general-purpose modifier for common item properties that don't warrant their own dedicated modifier class.
    GiveExpAction
    Gives experience points to the target player.
    GiveMoneyAction
    Deposits money into the target player's account via Vault.
    GivePermissionAction
    Grants a permission node to the target player.
    HasExpRequirement
    Checks whether a player has at least a specified amount of experience points.
    HasLevelRequirement
    Checks whether a player has at least a specified level.
    HasMoneyRequirement
    Checks whether a player has at least a specified amount of money via Vault.
    HasPermissionRequirement
    Checks whether a player has a specific permission node.
    InventoryConfigDeserializer
    Deserializes InventoryProvider instances from configuration nodes.
    InventoryContext
    Context object for inventory GUI operations, wrapping an ExecutionContext with GUI-specific state such as pagination.
    InventoryContext.Builder
    Builder for constructing InventoryContext instances.
    InventoryHandler
    Handles Bukkit inventory events for a managed GUI screen.
    InventoryHistoryRequirement
    Requires the player to have an inventory history of a specific size (e.g. for Back buttons).
    InventoryManager
    Central manager for player inventory GUI sessions with stack-based navigation.
    InventoryManagerImpl
    Production implementation of InventoryManager with stack-based navigation, a global auto-refresh ticker, and Bukkit event routing.
    InventoryOpenRequirement
    Requires the player to currently have a specific inventory open.
    InventoryProvider
    Defines the blueprint for creating and managing inventory GUI screens.
    InventoryView
    Represents a single instance of a GUI screen that is displayed to a player.
    InventoryViewImpl
    Default implementation of InventoryView that holds references to the view's ID, Bukkit inventory, context, and provider.
    ItemModifier
    Represents a single, composable transformation that can be applied to an ItemStack.
    ItemModifiers
    Central factory for creating ItemModifier instances.
    ItemPreconditions
    Minimal validation utilities for the itemstack package.
    ItemRequirement
    Checks whether a player has a specific item in their inventory.
    ItemStackBuilder
    A fluent builder for constructing ItemStack instances.
    ItemStackBuilders
    Static entry point for creating ItemStackBuilder instances.
    JsonConfigNode
    A ConfigNode implementation backed by Gson's JsonObject.
    KLibrary
    Main plugin class for KLibrary.

    LanguageManager
    Manages plugin localization and translations using Adventure API and MiniMessage.
    LanguageManagerImpl
     
    LeatherArmorModifier
    A modifier for dyeing leather armor.

    Sends a MiniMessage-formatted message to the target player.
    MessageService

    NamespaceKey

    Default implementation of ItemStackBuilder using the Paper API.

    Enum representing the available permission providers.

    Evaluates a dynamic condition via PlaceholderAPI.
    PlaceholderRequirement.Operator
    Supported comparison operators.

    Makes the target player execute a command.

    Service for safely detecting optional plugin dependencies at runtime.

    Pops the current inventory view from the player's stack, returning to the previous one.

    A modifier for configuring potion items (potions, splash potions, lingering potions, tipped arrows).

    Picks and executes a random action from a list of child actions.
    Requirement
    Represents a condition that must be evaluated before actions can execute.

    Deserializes Requirement instances from configuration nodes.

    The grouping mode for requirement evaluation.

    Registry for requirement types and their factories.
    RequirementResult
    Represents the outcome of a Requirement evaluation.

    SimpleRequirementRegistry
    Default implementation of the RequirementRegistry.

    A modifier for configuring player skull items.

    Plays a sound to the target player.
    SoundService
    Service for playing sounds to players with safe key resolution.

    Teleports the target player to specified coordinates.

    Sends a title and subtitle to the target player using Adventure API.

    Checks whether a player is in one of the specified worlds.
